changes_made.explanation: Consolidated guideline descriptions, removed redundant text, removed fluency and understandability criteria which were evaluated by automatic metrics (UniEval) not human evaluators. Kept only the explicit human evaluation criteria from MQM framework.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on quantifying self-bias in LLM self-evaluation across multiple NLG tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inclusion of methods/techniques that weren't actual evaluation metrics. The paper uses a combination of automatic metrics, LLM-as-judge, and human evaluation to study self-bias amplification in self-refinement pipelines.
